<!--
Writing rules (for the author, AI or human; comments are not rendered):
- Two audiences: Summary + Acceptance criteria are for the human approver. The collapsed section is for the implementer (usually an AI).
- State each fact once. Do not restate the problem in the solution, or repeat code references in prose.
- Summary: max 5 sentences, plain language, no file paths or type names.
- Technical section: one bullet per fact, terse, `path/File.cs:line` references, no narrative.
- Omit any section or field with nothing to say. Never write "N/A".
- No greetings or sign-off.
-->
